title: Quick Fish Wrap
description: A simple and delicious fish wrap that can be prepared in no time. This dish is perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: fish (cod or salmon)
ingredients.notes: Fresh or canned fish works well

ingredients.name: canadian lettuce
ingredients.notes: Romaine or iceberg lettuce works well

instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Season the fish with salt and pepper.
Add a small amount of oil to the pan and cook the fish for 3-4 minutes per side.
Meanwhile, toast the wrap in the pan for 1 minute on each side.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the quick fix sauce on the wrap, followed by the cooked fish, lettuce, and tomato.
Optional: Add some cheese, avocado, or pickles to the wrap for extra flavor.
